spanish: Torá una y juicio uno será a ustedes y al peregrino el peregrinante con ustedes.

findings.issue: Torá transliterates and capitalizes a common noun as a title; the token is a common feminine singular noun, not a proper name.

notes: The rest matches: feminine/masculine cardinals, 3ms imperfect, 2mp ustedes, and the sojourner plus the participle sojourning with you.
